canonical_validation_protocol.rationale: Per CLAUDE.md hard rule #19 expansion 2026-05-18: every voice ID default debe tener canonical_validation_status. States: validated | pending | deprecated_our_prod_only.
validation_methodology: 1. Sample test voice ID con 30s typical horror narration text
2. measure_F1.py WPM applied to TTS output
3. Compare per-speaker WPM band canonical (TODO Phase 1: implement measure-canonical-per-speaker.py via diarization)
4. User listen test acoustic perception ground truth (BLOCKING — programmatic alone insufficient per matadero CP2 lesson) — Rule D PRECEDENCE per AUDITOR-PROTOCOL § 3 CP2 M7.7.5
5. M7.7.5 semantic equivalence refinement for matarife/character voices: Rule A digit normalization + Rule B phonetic neighborhood + Rule C plurals/articles minor + Rule D user perceptual precedence
6. Mark status 'validated' only if BOTH programmatic + perceptual checks pass

workflow: 1. Generar TTS raw: .venv/bin/python scripts/tts.py -t '<texto>' -v 2gPFXx8pN3Avh27Dw5Ma -o assets/narr-raw.mp3  (default = Oxley)
2. Aplicar per-segment atempo: ffmpeg -y -i raw -af 'atempo=<raw_dur/target_dur clamped 0.7-2.5>' processed.mp3
3. Per-speaker multiplier on top: narrator ×1.15 / matarife ×1.28 / cocinera ×1.23 (SPEC pace_correction L660-672)
4. Matarife additional: SoX effects chain (pitch -300 + flanger + LPF 3500 + reverb + norm -16 + tempo)
5. M7 Whisper verify per-speaker ≥152.71 + M7.7.5 semantic equivalence refinement (digit/phonetic/perceptual rules)
rules: Verificar DEFAULT_VOICE_ID en scripts/tts.py antes de cada proyecto nuevo (debe ser 2gPFXx8pN3Avh27Dw5Ma Oxley).
NUNCA usar el raw en el render. Siempre el processed.mp3 con per-segment atempo.
Si una voz nueva se prueba y funciona, agregar acá con status 'validated' + validation_context completo.
Para matarife specifically: SoX effects chain obligatorio (ffmpeg LPF 2000+rubberband destruye consonants per matadero CP2 lesson 2026-05-18).
